claim_scope: aborted engineering execution; never scientific evidence
reason: The workbench source file was extended with a post-run evidence attestation after the process had imported it. The dataset manifest correctly retained the launch-time whole-file hash, but the exact launch-time source bytes were not copied into the run. Training was stopped rather than treating unreconstructable in-memory code as citable.
corrective_action: A fresh run directory must snapshot the exact workbench, runner, experiment wrapper, config, and requirements source bytes before update one, verify the generator hash against that snapshot, and perform a post-run current-evidence attestation. No checkpoint from this aborted run may be reused.
